description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Fraud Networks (fraud ring detection). Use when the user wants to detect fraud rings, multi-accounting or identity fraud clusters, list networks of users, businesses or transaction parties linked by a shared device, IP address, face, document number, phone, email or address, filter networks by status, risk band, signal type or pattern, inspect a network's members, signals, graph, timeline or map, download a network PDF report, or check whether a session, user, business, transaction or transaction party belongs to a fraud network using Didit. Networks are built automatically from production verifications and transactions; the API is read-only.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
